# `nlink-lab archive create`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Write an archive of a topology file, or of a running lab (`-L`)

Usage: nlink-lab archive create [OPTIONS] [FILE]

Arguments:
  [FILE]
          The topology file (`.nll`); without it, the lab

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

  -o, --output <OUTPUT>
          Where to write it (default: `./<name>.nlz`)

      --include-running-state
          Include the live state (PIDs, namespace names), for inspection

      --no-rendered
          Leave out the rendered topology

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          NLL `param` values recorded in the archive (repeatable)

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
